title: TRACE: Topology-Aware Reconnection via Prediction-Adaptive Connectivity Enforcement for Thin-Structure Segmentation
mechanism: For each skeleton point whose removal splits the local target skeleton, find the easiest valid reconnection under the current prediction among nearby target pixels and supervise its bottleneck pixel with a centred logit margin, so supervision follows the prediction rather than a fixed centreline.
adaptation: Implement in-house (3x3 local search, about 150 lines). As published the candidates are only label pixels, so on 1 to 2 px labels it stays on the drawn line; widen the candidate support to the crack label dilated by 1 px for this term only so the reconnection can follow the true dark ridge. Crack class only, weight 0.1 or 0.3 chosen on val.
min_experiment: PF + TRACE (dilated support) vs PF, 5 seeds. Metrics: relF1@2, components >= 20 px found, crack IoU, predicted width. Kill if relF1@2 gain < 0.01 or predicted width rises > 15%.
evidence: R: nnU-Net style training, 6 benchmarks. DeepCrack (270 train, CS2-Net backbone): Dice 82.78 to 85.20, beta error 6.16 to 3.69, clDice 89.03 to 91.10; SkelRecall 84.26 / 4.74; clDice 84.58 / 5.06. Stacks with SCNP on DRIVE and DSCA. Low memory and time overhead vs clDice / Betti matching.
prior_overlap: Partial: Skeleton Recall (fixed skeleton recall) and offset-tolerant CE were run; prediction-adaptive bottleneck supervision was not.

alt_notes.adaptation: Suits jittered labels: the model must connect the crack, not sit on the drawn line. In-house: build a graph from each crack component's label skeleton, run a min-cost path in a 3 px band on -log p(crack), and add CE on the bottleneck pixels. Cheap at 512 px with 0.19% crack pixels.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + TRACE-style bottleneck CE (crack), 5 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metrics: component recall (>= 20 px), relF1@2, crack IoU, width. Kill if component recall gain < 0.02 and relF1@2 gain < 0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: 2D re-implementation for crack only; addresses why fixed-skeleton losses misbehave under 1-2 px jitter.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm = PF + TRACE crack loss; baseline = PF and PF + Skeleton Recall w 0.1; 5 seeds; metrics components found, E1 relF1@2, IoU. Kill if no gain over Skeleton Recall w 0.1.
